story: Jane preserves the seed. Toph (woman) independently analyzes witness ancestry. Patricia tests repaired bridges.
gate_rule: Each new gate must cross a nonzero orthogonal GF(2) parity mask; weight 2/5 is enough for target gap 4/5 in the existing 11 cuts
source_rule: Every new bridge must trace to a distinct ultimate source root in a finite acyclic declared provenance DAG
witness_rule: Every observation must trace to a distinct witness root; signer identity must be distinct
signature_rule: Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON claim including cut, gate, source, observer, witness and graph SHA-256
limitations: All keys deterministic and public fixtures, not security credentials
Signatures authenticate a statement, not truth of underlying claim
Declared source and witness ancestries may be incomplete or false
Not an independent audit of real providers, code, hardware, or physical QCD
Lean candidate only; no complete formalization of cryptographic or graph proofs
next: H161 counterfactual evidence: three correctly signed witnesses can still agree on one copied observation
